_predeclaration_note: run7 (2026-09-09, seventh real-data cycle, PROP-NATIVE-04 -- ~/ANSE.ASIA/toledo/registry/proposals/native_retained_sensitivity.json). This file, split_manifest.json (copied unchanged from run6), and native_conformal_energy_threshold_derivation.json are committed in their OWN commit, BEFORE lab/run_native_conformal_energy.py is ever invoked against test.jsonl for run7. Same dataset/split/ICP backend/task tolerances as runs 2-6. rho and theta (new free parameters PROP-NATIVE-04 introduces) are derived from TRAIN alone (rho predeclared before any data was read; theta from the TRAIN-only m_k distribution at the final checkpoint), per honest_caveats Open risk 5. q_k (PROP-CONF-03's per-checkpoint Bonferroni conformal quantile) is calibrated on CALIBRATION only, following the same split-conformal recipe runs 1-3 already predeclared and used -- this is not a violation of the TRAIN/CALIBRATION/TEST discipline, only rho/theta specifically must come from TRAIN alone. A TRAIN+CALIBRATION-only diagnostic (native_conformal_energy_threshold_derivation.json) found, BEFORE test.jsonl was opened, that this construction is predicted to fail closed to 100% HOLD -- see native_conformal_energy.train_only_diagnostic_predicted_before_test above.

backend.name: in-repo numpy+scipy point-to-point ICP/Kabsch (lab/bop_icp_backend.py)
backend.model_weights: none (no learned model; closed-form SVD/Kabsch rigid-transform update each iteration)
backend.note: Backend gains one additive per-stage export (lab/adapter_bop.py:export_episode_native, native_sensitivity_stage_fields) exposing H_k and T_hat_k=(R_k,t_k); the Kabsch closed-form update itself is unchanged (same as run4). This run5 config/freeze commit is built on top of the theory/CONTINUUM_AUDIT_20260909.md commit (parent of this file's own commit).

dataset.name: BOP LineMOD-Occlusion (LM-O) test_bop19 subset, scene 000002
dataset.frame_prefilter: frames dropped from the sampling pool if either object has fewer than 300 mask_visib pixels with a nonzero real depth reading (real sensor dropout / heavy occlusion), applied before any random draw
dataset.frame_draw: 60 frames drawn without replacement from the prefiltered pool, numpy Generator seed 20260909
dataset.frame_split: 60 drawn frames permuted (numpy Generator seed 20260909) and cut 20/20/20 into TRAIN/CALIBRATION/FINAL TEST; all episodes (both objects) from one frame land in exactly one split
dataset.independent_sampling_unit: frame (not object-episode): the true number of independent draws is 60 frames, split 20/20/20; the two per-frame object episodes share the same depth-noise realization and are therefore not treated as independent units by the split rule
dataset.object_segmentation: dataset-provided ground-truth mask_visib for the target object in each frame; no online detector/segmentation network is executed -- this experiment tests the REFINEMENT stage only, not detection/segmentation
dataset.initial_pose: documented bounded random perturbation of real ground truth (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:perturb_pose): translation += isotropic Gaussian noise sigma=15mm per axis; rotation = random-axis rotation with angle ~ Uniform[5,20] degrees composed with ground-truth rotation. This simulates a coarse detector stage; it is not a full autonomous detection pipeline.
dataset.ground_truth_orthonormalization: BOP cam_R_m2c matrices are not exactly orthonormal at float precision (observed residual up to ~3e-4); both ground-truth and estimated rotations are projected to the nearest proper rotation via SVD (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:orthonormalize) before oracle error computation, applied identically to both.

estimator_side_stopping_rule: two consecutive ICP stages with |delta_t| <= 0.5mm and |delta_r| <= 0.1deg (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:estimator_converged); if never satisfied within the 15-iteration budget, lab/run_real_system.py's estimator_index() falls back to the terminal stage
timing_mode_reason: incremental_ms is real measured per-iteration wall-clock (cKDTree query + Kabsch SVD), but no separate online_policy_measured dual-policy execution was run; a latency-reduction PASS is therefore deliberately disabled by this timing_mode, matching lab/README.md section 5/7
inference_caveat: minimum_test_episodes=30 and independent_sampling_unit=episode are reused unchanged from lab/config.example.json's evaluator field, which the public evaluator (lab/run_real_system.py) treats as one unit per JSONL row (40 test rows satisfy minimum_test_episodes=30). This is a WEAKER independence assumption than dataset.independent_sampling_unit=frame above (only 20 independent test frames), because the evaluator has no native concept of frame-level clustering; the discrepancy is reported explicitly rather than silently reconciled, and the true independent count for power purposes is 20 frames, not 40 episodes.
tasks_reused_note: task reader kind/mask unchanged from lab/config.example.json and from run 1's config.json; only the numeric per-component tolerance was replaced with a value derived from TRAIN-split achievable ICP accuracy (75th percentile of the estimator-convergence-stage absolute pose error across the 40 TRAIN episodes, rounded up to 1mm / 1deg grid -- see TOLERANCE_DECISION.md). Components a task's mask does not use keep the original 1e9 sentinel unchanged.

native_sensitivity.reused_note: byte-identical to run5/run6 (lambda_ref=median TRAIN lambda_min(H_k), cap=p75 TRAIN local-dispersion-proxy norm); used here ONLY as the weld/M.40.v1 CEILING term (native_conformal_energy.ceiling below), not re-derived

native_conformal_energy.decision_mechanism: PROP-NATIVE-04: eps_kj=min(q_k/lambda_j, CEILING); Gamma_k=lambda_j*eps_kj^2 (Keystone quadratic-form energy); m_k=rho*m_{k-1}+iota_k*Gamma_k (decayed real-valued accumulator), checkpoint-indexed (k in {4,8,12,15}); ACT at first checkpoint k_m where m_{k_m}>=theta AND the checkpoint certificate condition holds (disclosed reading of q_{k_m}<=tau_i, see lab/native_conformal_energy.py module docstring)
native_conformal_energy.checkpoints_method: reused byte-identical from run3's own frozen Bonferroni checkpoint set (K'=4, the largest feasible value at n=40, alpha=0.1)
native_conformal_energy.ceiling_method: weld/M.40.v1 ceiling, reused byte-identical as run5/run6's own TRAIN-derived CAP (see honest_caveats Open risk 4: this proposal does not mint a new numeric ceiling)
native_conformal_energy.rho_method: predeclared, disclosed simplest non-extreme decay rate in (0,1); not tuned on TRAIN, calibration, or test outcomes
native_conformal_energy.theta_method: median, over 40 TRAIN episodes, of the checkpoint-indexed accumulator m_k evaluated at the last predeclared checkpoint k=15 with rho=0.5 -- see native_conformal_energy_threshold_derivation.json for the full per-task TRAIN diagnostic and honest pre-test prediction
native_conformal_energy.train_only_diagnostic_predicted_before_t: eps_{k,j} saturates at CEILING (0.03274911721483188) on 100% of TRAIN stage-checkpoint pairs for all 3 tasks -- q_k/lambda_j is uniformly LARGER than the reused ceiling on this backend/dataset, so the conformal-quantile numerator never actually influences the magnitude: eps collapses to being numerically IDENTICAL to run5/6's plain CAP. Separately, gate (b) (the checkpoint's own PROP-CONF-03 certificate condition) is TRUE on 0/40 TRAIN episodes at all 4 checkpoints for all 3 tasks -- reproducing run3's already-known certificate_rate=0.0 finding on this exact backend/model/checkpoints/alpha. Because ACT requires BOTH conditions, this predicts, BEFORE test.jsonl is opened, that PROP-NATIVE-04 will produce ACT rate near 0% (100% HOLD) on FINAL TEST -- the opposite failure mode from runs 5-6 (over-conservatism, not unsafe-early-ACT), consistent with the Toledo entry's own disclosed Open risk 1 and Open risk 2.
